##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 24 June 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, occasionally variable 3 or less at first, becoming easterly overnight, occasionally 5 in the southeast of the area for a time tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Easterly 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east of the area overnight into Friday. Gradually veering southerly overnight, although becoming northerly for a time in the far west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, showers later, possibly heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers later.
